descriptor_ABI: arithmetic-operator-query-v1 unchanged; derive from existing consumer specs
reason: width and bound-bit mapping alone merge a dense other operand with a zero-padded or shifted other operand
effective_operand_width: min(consumer operand width, consumer demanded result width); declaration-only high bits excluded
active_bits: effective width minus known-zero and known-one bit counts
end_runs: consecutive known-zero bits from each end of the effective operand
overlap_and_carry_span: same interval equations as the parent Add transforms, now applied to the two consumer operands
aggregation: maximum over local consumers; first qualified model remains limited to at most one Add consumer
known_one_or_nonzero_carry: explicitly rejected until separately qualified; dead high bits do not create live known-one features
model_input_exclusions: no view, NodeId, source/shape ID, graph hash, actual slack or mapped-cell counts
domain_policy: feature expression only; this extension does not relax numerical/load/neighborhood gates or grant prices
qualification: new fit must rederive fitting features from retained descriptors under this hash and freeze a successor; validation/error/coverage/refusal all required before independent test
